# hg nexus

**What this page tells you:** every `hg nexus` subcommand, with its arguments, flags and defaults.

The nexus ui plan compiler.

## Synopsis

```text
hg nexus validate [flags]
hg nexus compile [flags]
hg nexus print [flags]
hg nexus emit [flags]
hg nexus inspect <id> [flags]
hg nexus install [flags]
hg nexus prove [flags]
hg nexus features [flags]
hg nexus set <key=value>...
```

`--json` prints one JSON document on stdout; narration goes to stderr.

## Description

Compiles authored `dashboard/` contributions against the topology plan into the Nexus canvas. (`hg dash` reconciles Grafana ConfigMaps — unrelated.)

## `hg nexus validate`

```text
hg nexus validate [flags]
```

Authored dashboard/ files against their schemas.

| Flag | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--source` | `<repo-path-or-git-url>` | — | The contributing repo (alias `--dir`). |

## `hg nexus compile`

```text
hg nexus compile [flags]
```

Join contributions × the topology plan.

With `--gitops` it also writes the plan — `emit`'s contract spelling.

| Flag | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--source` | `<repo-path-or-git-url>` | — | The contributing repo (alias `--dir`). |
| `--dir` | `<repo-path-or-git-url>` | — | Alias of `--source`. |
| `--gitops` | `<gitops-repo-dir>` | — | GitOps repo to write the plan into (alias `--output`). |
| `--output` | `<gitops-repo-dir>` | — | Alias of `--gitops`. |
| `--environment` | `<file>` | — | The cluster half, overriding the repo's own: a legacy `topology.yaml`-shaped file (targets inline), or an environment spec (`infra/environments/<env>.yaml`) whose `grants` supply targets, DNS, policy and capability providers for the team's target-free `harness-hg/topology.yaml`. Team files (bundles, communication, capabilities) always come from the repo's `harness-hg/` (legacy: `environment/`). |
| `--workload-endpoints` | `<file.yaml>` | — | Workload endpoint declarations. |
| `--layout` | `single|replicated|hub-spoke` | — | Simulate a layout. |

**Examples**

```bash
hg nexus compile --source ../persona --gitops ../gitops
hg nexus prove --source ../persona
```

Team files (bundles, communication, capabilities) always come from the repo's `harness-hg/` (legacy: `environment/`). |

## `hg nexus install`

```text
hg nexus install [flags]
```

Copy the dashboard plugin into the local control-plane hermes and point it at --gitops.

| Flag | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--source` | `<repo-path-or-git-url>` | — | The repo providing the dashboard plugin (alias `--dir`). |
| `--gitops` | `<gitops-repo-dir>` | — | The GitOps clone the installed plugin reads. |

## `hg nexus prove`

```text
hg nexus prove [flags]
```

The devx acceptance matrix; artifacts under .hg/proofs/nexus/<timestamp>/.

Offline legs always run; live legs run against `--control-plane`.

| Flag | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--source` | `<repo-path-or-git-url>` | — | The contributing repo (alias `--dir`). |
| `--control-plane` | `<url>` | — | Base URL of the control plane (the exposed Nexus). |

## `hg nexus features`

```text
hg nexus features [flags]
```

List or flip workspace flags on the local install.

Needs no `--source`; applies without a restart.

| Flag | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--enable` | `id,..|all` | — | Flags to enable. |
| `--disable` | `id,..|all` | — | Flags to disable. |
| `--reset` | — | — | Restore registry defaults. |

## `hg nexus set`

```text
hg nexus set <key=value>...
```

Charts/nexus value overrides for the local install, applied on the next `up`.

Parity rule: anything the Pulumi bootstrap can configure must be configurable here too. An empty value clears; no args lists.
